name: 二进制基础
description: 理解二进制位权与基本表示
description_en: Understand binary place values and basic notation

name: 逻辑门基础
description: 理解与门、或门和非门的行为
description_en: Understand the behavior of AND, OR, and NOT gates

name: 真值表
description: 用输入输出组合描述逻辑行为
description_en: Describe logic behavior with input and output combinations

name: 布尔代数
description: 使用代数规则表示和变换逻辑函数
description_en: Represent and transform logic functions with algebraic rules

name: 最小项与最大项
description: 用规范项表达逻辑函数
description_en: Express logic functions with canonical terms

name: 卡诺图构成
description: 按格雷码相邻规则组织最小项

name: 卡诺图化简
description: 通过相邻分组得到更简洁的逻辑表达式
description_en: Derive simpler logic expressions by grouping adjacent cells

name: 组合逻辑设计
description: 根据规格完成无状态逻辑电路设计
description_en: Design stateless logic circuits from specifications

name: 半加器
description: 产生两个一位二进制数的和与进位
description_en: Produce sum and carry for two one-bit inputs

name: 全加器
description: 在半加器基础上加入进位输入
description_en: Add carry-in to one-bit binary addition

name: 编码器
description: 把独热输入转换为二进制编码
description_en: Convert one-hot inputs into a binary code

name: 锁存器
description: 用反馈保存一个二进制状态
description_en: Use feedback to retain one binary state

name: 触发器
description: 在时钟控制下保存状态

name: 寄存器
description: 组合多个触发器保存多位数据
description_en: Combine flip-flops to store multi-bit data

name: 计数器
description: 按时钟脉冲推进离散状态序列
description_en: Advance through a discrete state sequence on clock pulses
